@assertion the active prompt titled Azure OpenAI Deployment Name is visible.

Press Enter to submit the accepted text input.
@assertion the active prompt titled Programming Language is visible.

@assertion the active prompt titled Workspace Folder is visible and the option Default folder is focused.
